# Dor Tzabari

> Head of GTM with 8+ years experience building go-to-market at early-stage startups — and builder of an AI-native outbound engine (n8n workflows, LLM enrichment, human-approval gates in Slack).

## About

Dor Tzabari builds at the intersection of AI and product. He is interested in how language models change the way software gets made, used, and understood.

A GTM operator who builds from scratch. Over 8+ years he has taken products from early traction to enterprise adoption: qualified pipeline, paid POCs, and long-term commercial partnerships across the US, EMEA, and APAC.

Former IDF Captain (Yahalom — Combat Engineering Unit for Special Operations).

Lately: built and run an AI-native outbound engine on his own BD pipeline — n8n workflows built node by node, human-approval gates in Slack, a live metrics dashboard.

## Experience

### Head of GTM — DriveU.auto (2020–Present)
Provider of teleoperation and autonomy for vehicles, deployed across global autonomous fleets.
- Built and runs DriveU's AI outbound engine single-handedly — seven n8n workflows (120+ nodes) covering the full outbound chain: enrichment, ICP scoring, contact discovery, personalized outreach generation, Slack-native human approval and corrections
- Built a live GTM dashboard on the engine's data — funnel, conversion, velocity, and per-unit-cost metrics
- Built the revenue org's data layer through comprehensive market research, before any automation — a proprietary 600+ organization account map of the total addressable market
- DriveU's first GTM hire — founded and ran the entire outbound and RevOps function as a team of one; scaled a global pipeline to $5M+ ACV across US, EMEA, and APAC
- Converted that pipeline into 10 paid POCs and 4 multi-year commercial agreements ($300K–$1.5M ACV each)
- Cultivated C-level relationships at CES, MWC, Manifest

### Co-Founder & CEO — Greener Israel (2017–2020)
Smart-waste / smart-city platform; sole distributor of Bigbelly in Israel; flagship deployment with Tel Aviv Municipality across the entire Rothschild Boulevard.
- Full company buildout from founding through market entry (product, GTM, ops, legal)
- Flagship deployment with Tel Aviv Municipality on Rothschild Boulevard
- Negotiated sole-source vendor designation, eliminating competitive tender
- Raised $100K in pre-seed funding

## Projects

### Tuvia (co-founder, since April 2026)
An operating system for retirement advisors in Israel. Turns hours of manual pension and insurance mapping into one structured client view. Co-founded with a practicing retirement advisor, who is also the first user.
- Ingests clearinghouse (Masleka) exports across many institutions, parses and normalizes them into a single client view
- Hebrew RTL advisor workspace for products, insurance, deposits and flagged anomalies, plus a board for organizing client cases
- Ingest-to-workspace pipeline working end to end
- Next: a classification and recommendation layer built on Claude

### bdr-agent
AI outbound engine for a B2B startup — seven n8n workflows (120+ nodes) covering sourcing, enrichment, ICP scoring, contact discovery, personalized outreach generation, human approval, and metrics. Internal pilot under active iteration, deployed and live since April 2026.
Full case study: https://tzabari.dev/ai-outbound-engine.html
- Fixed pipeline over autonomous agent — built the agent variant too and chose the pipeline, so every step is auditable
- LLM as a bounded component: deterministic guardrails, ICP-score safety net with audit trail, anti-hallucination source filtering
- Slack human-approval gates + corrections loop with idempotent actions — staged human-in-the-loop rollout by design
- Live GTM metrics feed and dashboard over the engine's own data
- Cost instrumented per run (~$0.09 per enriched account) with per-task model routing (OpenAI GPT / Claude models, selected per task on cost/performance)
- Built one node at a time to understand every piece

### openclaw — configured for BD work
Non-standard use case design over OpenClaw (https://openclaw.ai), an open-source multi-channel agent runtime. Configured the platform for research and enrichment support in a team-of-one BD function.
- Recognized fit between an open-source runtime designed for chat and a single-person BD function that needed agentic support
- Configured platform defaults to serve a BD use case the platform wasn't marketed for

## Skills

GTM systems engineering: workflow orchestration (n8n), REST APIs & webhooks, prompt engineering for live GTM workflows, reliability engineering (error alerting, idempotent actions, deterministic validation), human-in-the-loop design, GTM dashboards & metrics, data hygiene & ICP scoring
Business: 0-to-1 GTM strategy, enterprise sales, strategic alliances, C-level engagement, pipeline architecture, product-market fit, fundraising, channel development, revenue operations
Tools: n8n, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenAI GPT / Claude models (selected per task on cost/performance), OpenClaw, Tavily, Apollo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Salesforce, Python & JavaScript (working familiarity)
